# Divine Favor (`spells:divine-favor`)
**Level 1 [Transmutation](../magic-schools/transmutation.md)** | **Casting Time:** Bonus Action | **Range:** Self
**Components:** V, S | **Duration:** 1 minute | **Classes:** [Paladin](../classes/paladin.md)
**Damage Type:** [Radiant](../damage-types/radiant.md)

Until the spell ends, your attacks with weapons deal an extra 1d4 Radiant damage on a hit.
